newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's Longometal merges A and B shares.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's Longometal merges A and B shares.

text.p: Morocco's metallurgic products importer Longometal Afrique merged its class A and B series shares into one series and doubled its capital to 94.6 million dirhams, a bourse official said on Tuesday.

Longometal, a subsidiary of conglomerate Societe Nationale d'Investissement, had a capital of 47.3 million dirhams before the increase. The decision was taken by the board of managers in June and adopted by a general assembly on September 27, he said.
"The new capital was set at 94.6 million dirhams divided into 946,080 shares of 100 dirhams nominal value each," the bourse said.
The new series will be quoted as of October 15.
The firm's turnover rose to 203.6 million dirhams in the first half of 1996, up from 140.1 million dirhams in the same period of 1995.
In its audited balance sheet, Longometal showed a pre-tax loss of 6.5 million dirhams in the first half of the year. It gave no comparative figures for the first half of 1995.
The firms shares were last traded on the Casablanca stock exchange at 155 dirhams on October 8.
